'''Şamaxı Futbol Klubu''' ({{IPA|az|ʃɑmɑˈxɯ|pron}}, {{lit|Shamakhi Football Club}}) is an Azerbaijani professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Shamakhi]], which competes in the [[Azerbaijan Premier League]]. The club has won the Premier League title twice.<ref>{{cite web|title=14 мгновений финала|url=http://azerifootball.com/ru/10/news/5710.html|access-date=26 May 2011|website=Azerifootball.com}}</ref> Previously the club was known as '''Xəzər Universiteti FK''' (1999–2004), '''İnter Bakı PİK''' (2004–2017) and '''Keşlə FK''' (2017–2022)."}}
